factorEvidence.name: thesisQuality
factorEvidence.basis: Operating momentum, diversified critical-material exposure and a concrete Winu social-licence milestone support the thesis, while commodity cyclicality and project execution remain explicit constraints.

factorEvidence.name: financialOperatingMomentum
factorEvidence.basis: 2025 EBITDA and operating cash flow improved and 2026 operating updates show volume and copper cost-guidance progress.

factorEvidence.name: catalystScore
factorEvidence.basis: Rincon financing and its stated 2028 first-production checkpoint create a dated catalyst alongside measurable 2026 operating ramps.

factorEvidence.name: governancePower
factorEvidence.basis: The Winu Project Agreement provides concrete consent and governance evidence with the Nyangumarta Warrarn Aboriginal Corporation; it does not establish FID or project economics.

factorEvidence.name: alignment2036
factorEvidence.basis: Copper, aluminium and lithium capacity pathways are directly exposed to electrification and infrastructure material demand.

factorEvidence.name: bottleneckControl
factorEvidence.basis: Existing diversified production plus commissioned/proposed copper, aluminium and lithium capacity addresses physical critical-material supply constraints.

factorEvidence.name: scenarioRobustness
factorEvidence.basis: Commodity diversification reduces single-commodity dependence, but cash generation remains sensitive to commodity prices, costs and project execution.

factorEvidence.name: supplyChainResilience
factorEvidence.basis: Operating and ramp evidence spans iron ore, copper, aluminium and lithium across multiple geographies.

riskEvidence.risk: Commodity-price weakness or cost inflation can offset volume and productivity gains.
Rincon remains a greenfield development; financing does not prove schedule, full ramp or realized economics, and IFC classifies it Environmental Category A.
Winu agreement advances social licence but does not establish FID, construction approval, production timing or project economics.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Identity/tradability are validated; packet lineage reports eight unique origins, eight primary sources and zero missing lineage. The permitted evidence still does not source-address marketValuationOpportunity, crossDivisionLeverage, substitutionResilience or pricingPower.

limitations: No numeric score is produced because four Methodology 1.0 components remain unsupported by the permitted source-addressed evidence.
Prospective project outcomes are not treated as realized.
